# Policy Memos Resource

> > A Harvard Kennedy School resource documenting significant government policy memos across presidential administrations, national security decisions, civil rights history, and public accountability.

This site archives and analyzes policy memos from the White House, federal agencies, and local governments, spanning historic documents like the 1963 NAACP civil rights memo to contemporary Biden administration directives. It serves as an educational resource for understanding how policy decisions are communicated and documented across different levels of government.

## Key Topics

- Presidential transitions and executive orders
- Biden-Harris Administration policy
- Government accountability and transparency
- Foreign policy and national security
- Civil rights and racial equity
- COVID-19 response
- Climate policy
- Freedom of Information Act (FOIA)
- Records preservation
- Iraq War and Rumsfeld memos
- Soviet Union and Cold War policy
- Federal agency operations
- Local government policy
- Whistleblower communications
- Documentary evidence and historical memos

## Presidential Administration Memos

- [1/16/2020 Memo from Incoming White House Chief of Staff - First Ten Days of the Biden Administration](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/news/test-number-t): Ron Klain memo on Biden-Harris first ten days: COVID, climate, equity
- ["Our Response to Soviet Intervention in Afghanistan," a Memo to President Jimmy Carter, From: Assistant for National Security Affairs, Date: 12/29/79](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/blog/sample-blog-entry): Brzezinski memo to Carter on Cold War response to Soviet Afghanistan invasion
- [12/05/20 Washington Post - Historians sue Trump administration to stop 'bonfire of records in Rose Garden'](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/blog/120520-washington-post-historians-sue-trump-administration-stop-bonfire-records): Washington Post coverage of historians' lawsuit on Trump records preservation

## Foreign Policy and National Security

- [United Nations advises staff against using 'war' or 'invasion' regarding Ukraine](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/news/united-nations-advises-staff-against-using-%E2%80%98war%E2%80%99-or-%E2%80%98invasion%E2%80%99-regarding-ukraine): UN staff guidance memo on diplomatic terminology for Russia-Ukraine conflict
- ["New York Times" Opinion Guest Essay: "Donald Rumsfeld's Fog of Memos" by Errol Morris](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/news/opinion-errol-morris-director-2013-film-about-donald-rumsfeld-discusses-passing): Errol Morris NYT essay on Rumsfeld memos and Iraq War accountability
- [USAID Memo from Nicholas Enrich, March 4, 2025](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/resource/usaid-memo-nicholas-enrich-march-4-2025): USAID memo by Nicholas Enrich on global health and humanitarian assistance

## Civil Rights and Racial Justice

- [From: NAACP Exec. Secretary To: President of Branches, et al., Re: Nat'l. Civil Rights Legislative Conference, Date: 7/25/63](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/links/naacp-exec-secretary-president-branches-et-al-date-072563-re-natl-civil-rights-leg): Historic 1963 NAACP memo on National Civil Rights Legislative Conference
- [From: Town Manager, Amherst, MA., To: Town Council, Re: Funds Appropriated to Address Systemic Racism, Date: 3/18/2021](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/links/memo-town-manager-amherst-ma-town-council-re-funds-appropriated-address-systemic): Amherst, MA Town Manager memo on FY21 funds for racial justice initiatives

## Federal Agency Operations and Accountability

- [From: U.S. Postmaster General, To: U.S. Postal Employees, Re: Directive to leave mail behind at distribution centers, Date: 07/10/2020](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/links/memo-us-postmaster-general-louis-dejoy-us-postal-employees-re-directive-leave-mail): USPS Postmaster General directive on operational changes and mail delivery
- [Harvard's Jane Rosenzweig reviews "Whistleblower" memo in New York Times](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/blog/harvards-jane-rosenzweig-reviews-whistleblower-memo-new-york-times): Jane Rosenzweig's NYT analysis of whistleblower memo writing and clarity

## Local Government Policy

- [From: Equipment Policy Ad Hoc Committee, To: Oakland Police Commission, Re: Police Equipment Policy, Date: 6/7/2020](https://policymemos.hks.harvard.edu/links/memo-equipment-policy-ad-hoc-committee-oakland-police-commission-re-police): Oakland Police Commission memo on controlled equipment policy regulations
